summary: The focused obligation is necessary. The old harness cannot reach typed validation of an object member on either source version.

assessment.necessity_reason: Both versions support unpacking an object member with the string format, which rejects a non-string value. A valid input such as {"data":1} provides a finite trigger. The complete entry uses only the type-insensitive o format for object members, and its other unpack calls provide no equivalent route.

before.requirement: Unpacking an object member with the string format rejects a selected non-string member.
before.reason: Object-member lookup delegates to the selected value format. The string format rejects a non-string value, but the old harness selects o for the member.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object-member lookup passes the selected value to unpack for format-specific validation.

after.requirement: Unpacking an object member with the string format rejects a selected non-string member.
after.reason: The string type check remains available after the change, but the same old harness still selects o for the member.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object-member lookup still passes the selected value to unpack for format-specific validation.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The fuzzer bytes can supply a valid object containing a non-string data member.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same {s?o} member format prevents string type validation before and after the change.
